map.按参数量与字节数估算权重显存。: Estimate weight VRAM from parameter count and bytes per parameter.
map.权重显存 ≈ 参数量 × 每参数字节数；总显存 ≈ 权重 + 激活/1000: Weight VRAM ~ parameters x bytes per param; total VRAM ~ weights + activation/1000
map.推理显存主要由权重决定：FP16 为 2 字节、INT8 为 1 字节、FP32: Inference VRAM is mainly determined by weights: FP16 is 2 bytes, INT8 is 1 byte, FP32 is 4 bytes. Training also adds gradients and Adam states (one and two extra copies of weights respectively), plus activation values that grow with batch and sequence length, often several times the weights themselves.
map.训练还需优化器状态（通常 2–4 倍权重）。: Training also needs optimizer states (usually 2-4x the weights).
map.权重显存≈参数量×每参数字节数(FP16=2, INT8=1, FP32=4)。: Weight VRAM ~ parameters x bytes per param (FP16=2, INT8=1, FP32=4).
map.推理显存还需加激活/KV 缓存，训练另需梯度与优化器状态(常数倍于权重)。: Inference VRAM also needs activation/KV cache; training additionally needs gradients and optimizer states (constant multiples of weights).
map.估算用于硬件选型、batch 设定与显存溢出预警。: The estimate is used for hardware selection, batch setting and VRAM-overflow warning.
map.7B 参数 FP16：权重≈7e9×2=14GB；加 KV 缓存与激活后推理约: 7B params FP16: weights ~ 7e9 x 2 = 14GB; with KV cache and activation, inference is about 16-18GB, runnable on a 24GB GPU; if training, add gradients + optimizer (~ 3-4x weights).
map.为什么训练显存远大于推理？: Why is training VRAM much larger than inference?
map.训练需保留前向激活供反向、存梯度(同尺寸)与优化器状态(Adam 约 2 倍权重: Training must keep forward activations for backprop, store gradients (same size) and optimizer states (Adam about 2x weights), often bringing total VRAM to 3-4x the weights; inference only needs weights + a little activation.
map.量化降权重字节数、用梯度检查点换计算省激活、降 batch、或模型并行/张量并行: Quantize to reduce weight bytes, use gradient checkpointing to trade compute for activation savings, reduce batch, or use model/tensor parallel sharding; if necessary, use larger VRAM or distribution.
map.显存估算（本页代码口径）：权重显存 W=参数量(十亿)×每参数字节数（FP32=: VRAM estimate (this page): weight memory W = parameters (billions) x bytes per parameter (FP32=4, FP16=2, INT8=1); total = W + activation MB / 1000 x recompute factor (off 1, on 0.5) + KV cache GB + optimizer/gradient GB / ZeRO shards. Target VRAM accepts 8/16/24/48 GB and the result shows headroom or overage. Validation: charts render only when parameters and bytes per parameter are >0; empty values fall back to 0. Note: sequence parallelism (SP/Ulysses) can further divide per-GPU activation by its degree, but communication and pipeline bubbles are not modelled; verify with measured VRAM at the same scale.
map.显存判读（与上式互补）：总显存随参数量线性增长，页面按 1/3/7/13/30/: VRAM reading (complements the formula above): total memory grows linearly with parameters; the page scans 1/3/7/13/30/70B and plots a line. Memory per billion parameters equals bytes per parameter (GB); activation MB is converted to GB by /1000; recompute-on applies a 0.5 factor and ZeRO shards divide optimizer/gradient memory by the shard count. Validation: same as above; charts render only when parameters and bytes per parameter are >0. Criteria: no fixed tiers; halving precision bytes halves weight memory. Presets cover six real scenarios: FP16 inference, FP32 training, INT8 quantisation, LoRA, QLoRA and 70B INT4.
map.静态参数/权重体积对照，便于按显存档位选模型。权重 GB = 参数量 × 字节/: Static parameter and weight-size comparison to pick a model for your VRAM tier. Weight GB = parameters x bytes per parameter (FP16=2, INT8=1, INT4=0.5), excluding KV cache and activations.
map.按模型名筛选，如 llama: Filter by model name, e.g. llama
map.没有匹配的模型，请调整筛选条件。: No matching models. Adjust the filters.

map.权重字节数等于参数量乘每参数字节数，半精为二字节单精为四字节: Weight bytes equal parameter count times bytes per parameter: two bytes for half precision, four for single precision
map.激活占用随批次与序列长度线性增长，往往超过权重本身: Activation footprint grows linearly with batch and sequence length and often exceeds the weights themselves
map.框架缓存与碎片需要额外预留，实际可用显存应留出余量: Framework caches and fragmentation need extra reservation, so usable VRAM should keep headroom
